text: People don't care as much about what you do
And so many times we're worrying if we fail.
We're worrying if it doesn't go good.
We're worrying if we embarrass ourselves.
The most embarrassing thing we could ever do
is get to the end of your life
You left all of it on the table
and you don't get another shot.
That's more scary to me than anything else.
Getting to the end and realize you freaking missed it.
